description: This PHP source file defines an Admin Controller class 'Topic' for managing CMS topics in an OpenCart-based e-commerce platform. It includes methods for listing, creating, editing, enabling, disabling, and deleting topics, along with handling form submissions and rendering views.

classes.name: Topic
classes.description: Controller class for managing CMS topics within the OpenCart admin panel, extending the core Controller class.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that sets up the topic listing page, loads necessary language, models, and views, and prepares data for output.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX or direct requests to display the list of topics by invoking getList.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares the list of topics based on filters, sorting, and pagination, returning the rendered view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a topic, loading current data if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes form submission for creating or updating a topic, including validation and permission checks.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables selected topics by setting their status to active.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables selected topics by setting their status to inactive.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected topics from the database.
